about: src/lib/inventory_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend runs the same rules from madar-inventory). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and features/inventory/lib.test.ts runs the dashboard's transfer rules against it.
